summary: Alabama beat Texas A&M 31-20 with a decisive fourth quarter. Henry’s pressure and Scott’s receiving production lead the review; the kicking operation remains a concern before the open week and LSU.

items.headline: Alabama closes with a 14-0 fourth quarter to win 31-20
items.tldr: The defense held Texas A&M to 15 yards in the final period. Carry that control into earlier possessions rather than relying on another late takeover.

items.headline: Henry supplies two fourth-quarter sacks
items.tldr: BamaCentral traces the defensive finish after Alabama trailed. Watch the pass rush’s spacing as well as its speed when the quarterback tries to extend the down.

items.headline: Scott catches six passes for 156 yards
items.tldr: The receiving production gave Russell a way to move the offense. Watch the route spacing that creates a clean throw before asking for yards after the catch.

items.headline: Talty misses from 36 and 42 yards against Texas A&M
items.tldr: He made one of three field-goal attempts. Use the open week to inspect the whole operation: snap, hold, protection and contact.

items.headline: Alabama visits LSU November 7 at 2:30 p.m. CT
items.tldr: ABC will carry the game after Alabama’s open date. Set the afternoon viewing window and use the break to follow personnel updates.

lead.headline: Carry the finish into the first drive.
lead.body: Pair the pass rush with coverage that survives the first escape. On offense, give the quarterback a clear receiving answer and make the kicking operation dependable when a drive stops short.

matchup.question: What should fans watch in the next game?
matchup.answer: Keep protection and route spacing connected. Finish defensive downs with controlled pursuit, and give the kicking unit an organized opportunity when the offense cannot reach the end zone.

signals.title: Defensive pass rush
signals.detail: Keep the edge and inside pressure aimed at the same escape point. A fast arrival matters when the rest of the front can finish the quarterback’s next move.

signals.title: Receiving answers
signals.detail: Watch the space between the underneath option and the deeper target. Give the quarterback a clean first decision before the pocket tightens.

signals.detail: Inspect the snap, hold and protection before judging the flight. Keep the operation calm when the drive ends with a field-goal attempt.
